laws.name: creation-budget
laws.rule: per lane per 7d: opens <= finishes + 2; finishes = merges + purposeful closes

laws.name: reservoir-surveillance
laws.red_effect: drain-only, total creation freeze except breakage correctives
laws.trend_rule: 3 consecutive daily rises => drain action within 24h, report to director after acting

laws.name: escalation-ladder
steps: fix then report solved with proof
ask the other seats same day
director asked only at genuine human gates
laws.violation: silence about a known problem, including reporting a number without acting on its meaning

laws.name: finish-first
laws.overdue_effect: item past finish_by blocks all new starts in its lane until finished, re-dated with cause, or closed

laws.name: quality-loop
laws.rule: purpose-valid items iterate scorecard-fix-rescore until >=9 or purpose re-test fails; max 2 iterations before purpose re-test

laws.name: whole-before-part
laws.rule: every creation states the whole-system snapshot and why the action improves the whole; lane-local benefit with system-level cost fails

regime_falsifier: any week closing with open_count higher than it opened while all lanes report compliance => laws are theater; escalate to director with evidence
source_event: reservoir-night-2026-10-20: 662 open PRs; close wave 472; purpose ledger KEEP 60 / CLOSED 25 / PROVE-48h 105; live 165
title: NEVER AGAIN — The Reservoir Laws
